Training.title: Quick Farming Tips
Training.noTipsFound: No tips found matching your search.
Training.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this training video tutorial?

tip6.title: Weaning Age for Smallholders
tip6.content: Wean piglets at 28 to 35 days instead of earlier. This allows piglets to grow stronger and adapt to solid feed using simple farm resources.

tip7.title: Gradual Separation Method
tip7.content: Reduce weaning stress by moving the sow out of the farrowing pen and leaving the piglets in their familiar environment for the first week.

tip8.title: Draft Prevention for Weaners
tip8.content: Block cold winds in the nursery pen by installing temporary curtains or wooden boards up to piglet-height (about 50cm).

tip11.title: Homemade Rehydration Solution
tip11.content: Feed a cheap, homemade electrolyte solution (5 tablespoons sugar, 1/2 tablespoon salt in 5 liters clean water) during the first 3 days of weaning to combat stress.

tip17.title: Clay Soil Mineral Supplement
tip17.content: Put a clean shovel of fresh, red clay soil (from a clean area) in the farrowing/weaning pen. Piglets eat it to get natural iron and minerals.

tip20.title: Agricultural Byproduct Boiling
tip20.content: Boil agricultural byproducts like yam peels, cassava peels, and potato vines to destroy natural toxins and improve digestibility.

tip21.title: Local Protein Sources
tip21.content: Supplement commercial feed by growing high-protein forage crops like Moringa, Azolla, or sweet potato leaves on the farm.

tip22.title: Gestation Feed Restriction
tip22.content: Limit gestating sows to 2-2.5 kg of feed per day to prevent them from becoming overweight, which causes difficult births.

tip26.title: Boiling Kitchen Waste
tip26.content: Boil hotel or kitchen food waste for 30 minutes to destroy African Swine Fever and Foot-and-Mouth disease viruses.

tip28.title: Charcoal for Digestion
tip28.content: Place small pieces of wood charcoal in grower pens. Pigs chew it to help bind stomach toxins and reduce diarrhea.

tip34.title: Hand Mating in Breeding Pen
tip34.content: Bring the sow in heat to the boar's pen for breeding, rather than letting the boar run loose in the sow herd.

tip35.title: Standing Heat Response
tip35.content: Test for heat by pressing your hands firmly on the sow's back; if she stands completely still and stiffens her ears, she is ready to mate.

tip39.title: DIY Crushed Piglet Protection
tip39.content: Install "guard rails" (heavy wooden poles or metal pipes placed 20cm out from the walls and 20cm off the floor) in farrowing pens.

tip43.title: Breeding Records Calendar
tip43.content: Mark the breeding date on a calendar; pregnancy lasts 114 days (3 months, 3 weeks, 3 days), allowing you to prepare the farrowing pen.

tip47.title: Gilt First Mating Age
tip47.content: Wait until a gilt is at least 8 months old and on her second or third heat cycle before mating her to ensure a larger first litter.

tip48.title: Isolation of New Purchases
tip48.content: Keep newly purchased pigs in a separate pen at least 20 meters away from your main herd for 30 days to check for sickness.

tip49.title: DIY Footbath Setup
tip49.content: Place a shallow plastic tub or half-cut tire filled with water and disinfectant (like chlorine or agricultural lime) at the farm gate.

tip51.title: Visitor Restriction Policy
tip51.content: Do not allow visitors (especially other pig buyers or farmers) inside your pig pens. Discuss business outside the pen area.

tip55.title: Natural Parasite Control
tip55.content: Feed crushed papaya seeds or pumpkin seeds to grower pigs as a cheap, natural remedy to help reduce internal worms.

tip60.title: Proper Burial of Mortalities
tip60.content: Bury dead pigs at least 2 meters deep, far away from water sources, and cover the carcass with agricultural lime before refilling the soil.

tip61.title: Low-Cost Pen Space
tip61.content: Provide at least 1 square meter of space per finisher pig to reduce fighting, stress, and skin lesions.

tip62.title: Natural Cross-Ventilation
tip62.content: Design pig houses with open sides (using wire mesh or bamboo slats) to allow natural breeze to blow through and remove odors.

tip75.title: DIY Compost Piles
tip75.content: Pile pig manure in a designated dry corner, cover it with banana leaves or plastic, and turn it weekly with a shovel to make compost.

tip76.title: Flexible Bag Biogas
tip76.content: Install a simple, low-cost plastic tubular biogas digester to treat pig manure, producing free cooking gas for the household.

tip92.title: Castration Age Limit
tip92.content: Castrate male piglets before they are 7 days old. At this age, the procedure is fast, heals quickly, and causes minimal pain.

tip94.title: Simple Notebook Records
tip94.content: Keep a small, cheap notebook in the barn to write down breeding dates, farrowing dates, and treatments for each sow.

dis_melioidosis.description: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya okuva mu ttaka/amazzi.

dis_trypanosomiasis.description: Obulwadde bwa protozoan obusaasaanyizibwa ensekere za tsetse.

dis_cysticercosis.description: Omutendera gw’enkwaso (larval stage) y’ensowera y’omuntu mu binywa by’embizzi.

dis_listeriosis.name: Obulwadde bwa Listeriosis
dis_listeriosis.description: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya mu nkola y’obusimu.

dis_ear_necrosis.description: Ebiseera ebisinga kiva ku situleesi, omujjuzo oba yinfekisoni.
dis_ear_necrosis.prevention: Okukendeeza ku density n’okujjanjaba yinfekisoni ey’okubiri.

dis_iron_toxicity.name: Obutwa bw’ekyuma
dis_iron_toxicity.description: Kiyinza okubaawo singa ekyuma kifukibwa mu baana b’embizzi ababulamu Vit E.
dis_iron_toxicity.prevention: Kakasa nti emmere y’okusiga ebeera ya bbalansi.

dis_aflatoxicosis.name: Obulwadde bwa Aflatoxicosis
dis_aflatoxicosis.description: Obutwa obuva mu mpeke oba emmere erimu ekikuta ekivaako ekibumba okwonooneka n’okuzimba ekibumba.
dis_aflatoxicosis.prevention: Weewale okuliisa emmere erimu ekikuta, tereka empeke mu mbeera enkalu, era kozesa ebisiba obutwa.

dis_parakeratosis.name: Obulwadde bwa Parakeratosis (Obulwadde bwa Zinc) .
dis_parakeratosis.description: Obulwadde bw’endya obuleeta ebiwundu by’olususu eby’amaanyi ebizimba, ebigonvu.
dis_parakeratosis.prevention: Kakasa nti omugerageranyo gwa calcium ne zinc gukwatagana mu mmere y’emmere era owe ebirungo ebiyamba zinc.

dis_biotin_deficiency.description: Ebbula ly’emmere ekivaako ebigere okwatika, ebiwundu ku lususu, n’okulema.
dis_biotin_deficiency.prevention: Okwongera ku mmere ne biotin era weewale wansi wa seminti omukalu era omubisi.

dis_gossypol_toxicity.name: Obutwa bwa Gossypol
dis_gossypol_toxicity.description: Obutwa obuva mu kuliisa obuwunga bwa ppamba obubisi oba obuyitiridde, ekivaako obuzibu mu kussa.
dis_gossypol_toxicity.prevention: Komya emmere ya ppamba mu mmere era kozesa iron sulfate okumalawo gossypol.

dis_cassava_poisoning.name: Obutwa bwa Kaawa
dis_cassava_poisoning.description: Obutwa bwa Cyanide okuva mu bikoola oba ebikuta bya muwogo ebibisi oba ebitali bituufu.
dis_cassava_poisoning.prevention: Sekula, fumba, okukala mu musana oba okuzimbulukusa muwogo nga tonnaba kuliisa.

dis_sweet_potato_toxicity.name: Obutwa mu Sweet Potato
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity.description: Obutwa obuva mu bitooke ebifuuse ekikuta, ekivaako obuzibu obw’amaanyi mu kussa.
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity.prevention: Suula ebitooke ebyonooneddwa oba ebifuuse ekikuta; liisa ebikuta ebiramu byokka.

dis_mma.name: Obulwadde bwa Dysgalactia oluvannyuma lw’okuzaala (MMA) .
dis_mma.description: Obulwadde bw’amabeere, obulwadde bwa metritis, ne agalactia ebivaako omusujja n’obutaba na mata mu nte oluvannyuma lw’okuzaala.
dis_mma.prevention: Kuuma obuyonjo obukakali obw’ekiyumba ky’okuzaala n’okukakasa nti endya emala ey’okusiga.

dis_pwd.name: Ekiddukano oluvannyuma lw’okuggya ku mabeere (PWD) .
dis_pwd.description: Ekiddukano kya bakitiriya mu baana b’embizzi nga wayiseewo akaseera katono nga bavudde ku mabeere, ekivaako okuggwaamu amazzi mu mubiri.
dis_pwd.prevention: Kendeeza ku situleesi y’okuggya ku mabeere, kuuma obuyonjo obw’amaanyi, n’okuwa amazzi amayonjo ag’okunywa.

dis_trichinellosis.name: Obulwadde bwa Trichinellosis
dis_trichinellosis.description: Zoonotic parasitic disease okuva mu kulya ebisasiro by’ennyama embisi, ekivaako ebinywa okukaluba.
dis_trichinellosis.prevention: Toliisa swill embisi, fumba ebisasiro by’emmere okumala eddakiika 30, n’okufuga ebiwuka.

dis_hydatid_disease.name: Obulwadde bwa Hydatidosis
dis_hydatid_disease.description: Obulwadde bw’enkwaso (parasitic larval infection) obuleeta ebizimba ebijjudde amazzi mu bitundu by’omubiri.
dis_hydatid_disease.prevention: Embwa z’oku ffaamu ziggyamu ensowera buli kiseera n’ozireme okulya ebitundu by’embizzi ebibisi.

dis_phe.name: Obulwadde bw’omu lubuto obuvaamu omusaayi mu mbizzi
dis_phe.description: Ekiddukano eky’omusaayi ogw’amaanyi n’okufa okw’amangu mu mbizzi ezirima/ezimaliriza.
dis_phe.prevention: Kuuma obuyonjo obulungi era kozesa eddagala eritta obuwuka erisaanira wansi w’obulagirizi bw’omusawo w’ebisolo.

dis_mycoplasma_arthritis.name: Obulwadde bw’endwadde z’enkizi (Mycoplasmal Arthritis).
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis.description: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuvaako ennyondo okuzimba, okulema, n’amagulu okunafuwa.
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis.prevention: Okulongoosa embeera y’amayumba, okukendeeza ku bungi bw’ebintu ebiterekeddwa, n’okujjanjaba nga bukyali.

dis_foot_rot.name: Okuvunda kw’ebigere (Necrobacillosis) .
dis_foot_rot.description: Obuwuka obuleeta obuwuka obuyingira mu buvune mu bigere, ekivaako okuvunda n’okulema.
dis_foot_rot.prevention: Ddabiriza seminti omukalu, wansi kuuma nga mukalu, era kozesa ebinaabirwamu bwe kiba kyetaagisa.

dis_babesiosis.name: Obulwadde bwa Babesiosis obuleetebwa enkwale
dis_babesiosis.description: Ekiwuka ky’omusaayi ekitambuzibwa enkwale ekivaako omusujja omungi, okukendeeza omusaayi n’omusulo omuddugavu.
dis_babesiosis.prevention: Fuga enkwale ng’okozesa eddagala eritta enkwale era okuume ekkalaamu nga teziriimu bimera.

dis_anaplasmosis.name: Obulwadde bwa Anaplasmosis
dis_anaplasmosis.description: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuva ku nkwale obuleeta okukendeeza ku musaayi, omusujja, n’obulwadde bwa jaundice.
dis_anaplasmosis.prevention: Teeka mu nkola pulogulaamu z’okufuga vector ne tick.

dis_sow_hysteria.name: Siga Hysteria (Obulwadde bwa Hysteria).
dis_sow_hysteria.description: Obuzibu mu nneeyisa ng’embizzi ezizaala zifuuka za bukambwe ne ziluma omwana w’embizzi.
dis_sow_hysteria.prevention: Waayo embeera esirifu ey’okuzaala, londoola gilts, era kozesa eddagala eriweweeza ku bulwadde bwe kiba kyetaagisa.

dis_thorny_headed_worm.name: Ensigo ey’omutwe ogw’amaggwa
dis_thorny_headed_worm.description: Ensigo eyitibwa parasitic worm efunibwa olw’okulya enkwale, ekivaako okukutuka kw’ekyenda.
dis_thorny_headed_worm.prevention: Weewale okulunda mu ddembe ku ttaka eririmu enkwale era kozesa eddagala eritta ensowera.

dis_strongyloidiasis.name: Obulwadde bwa Strongyloidiasis (Obulwadde bw’obuwuzi) .
dis_strongyloidiasis.description: Ensigo y’omu byenda ereeta ekiddukano eky’amaanyi n’okufa mu baana b’embizzi.
dis_strongyloidiasis.prevention: Ebibokisi by’okuzaala bikuume nga bikalu era nga biyonjo, era n’okuggya ensowera mu nsigo nga tonnazaala.

dis_hyostrongylosis.name: Ensigo Y’omu Lubuto Emmyufu
dis_hyostrongylosis.description: Obulwadde bw’ensowera mu lubuto ekivaako okuzimba olubuto, okukendeera kw’omusaayi, n’okugejja.
dis_hyostrongylosis.prevention: Kyuusa amalundiro, ennyumba zikuume nga nkalu, era oteeke mu nkola enteekateeka y’okutta ensowera.

dis_oesophagostomiasis.name: Obulwadde bw’ensowera eziyitibwa Nodular Worm
dis_oesophagostomiasis.description: Ekiwuka ky’ekyenda ekivaako ebizimba mu bbugwe w’ekyenda, ekivaako enkoko ennyimpi.
dis_oesophagostomiasis.prevention: Obuyonjo bw’ekkalaamu buli kiseera n’okukozesa eddagala eriweweeza ku bulwadde bwa broad-spectrum anthelmintics bulijjo.

dis_fascioliasis.name: Obulwadde bwa Fascioliasis (Obulwadde bw’ekibumba) .
dis_fascioliasis.description: Obulwadde bwa parasitic fluke obukosa ekibumba, obutera okubeera mu malundiro amabisi oba ag’entobazzi.
dis_fascioliasis.prevention: Zitangira embizzi okuliisa mu bifo ebirimu entobazzi n’okufuga ensenene z’ebitosi.

dis_emcv.name: Obulwadde bw’emisuwa gy’obwongo (EMCV) .
dis_emcv.description: Obulwadde bw’akawuka obuva mu nvunza obuvaako omutima okulemererwa mu bwangu n’okuggyamu embuto.
dis_emcv.prevention: Teeka mu nkola enkola enkakali ey’okulwanyisa ebiwuka n’okukuuma emmere okuva ku bucaafu.

dis_demodectic_mange.name: Omulimu gwa Demodex Mange
dis_demodectic_mange.description: Enkwaso z’olususu ezirabika obulungi ezireeta amabala n’obuzimba obutonotono.
dis_demodectic_mange.prevention: Okulongoosa endya y’ekisibo, okwawula embizzi ezikoseddwa, n’okusiiga eddagala eritta acaricides.

dis_pityriasis_rosea.name: Obulwadde bwa Pityriasis Rosea
dis_pityriasis_rosea.description: Embeera y’olususu etali ya kusiigibwa mu mbizzi ento ezikola ebikuta ebiringa empeta.
dis_pityriasis_rosea.prevention: Ebiseera ebisinga okwesalirawo; okukuuma ebitanda ebiyonjo era ebikalu n’okukendeeza ku situleesi.

dis_photosensitization.name: Okuwunyiriza ekitangaala
dis_photosensitization.description: Okukola ennyo ng’okwokya omusana mu mbizzi ez’olususu olutangaavu oluvannyuma lw’okulya ebimera ebitongole.
dis_photosensitization.prevention: Okuwa ekisiikirize, ggyawo omuddo oguwunyiriza, era embizzi zikuume mu nnyumba.

dis_shoulder_ulcers.name: Siga Amabwa Ku Kibegabega
dis_shoulder_ulcers.description: Amabwa aga puleesa ku bibegabega by’embizzi ennyimpi eziteekeddwa ku seminti omukalu.
dis_shoulder_ulcers.prevention: Waayo ebitanda ebigonvu, kuuma enkoko nga ziri mu mbeera nnungi, era kozesa ebitanda bya kapiira.

dis_ear_biting.name: Okulya abantu mu matu
dis_ear_biting.description: Enneeyisa etali ya bulijjo ng’embizzi ziluma amatu ga bannaabwe mu kiyumba, ekivaako okufa.
dis_ear_biting.prevention: Kendeeza ku mujjuzo, okulongoosa empewo, n’okugaggawaza ng’enjegere.

dis_gastric_torsion.name: Okuwuguka kw’olubuto (Bloat) .
dis_gastric_torsion.description: Okuzimba n’okukyusakyusa olubuto mu bwangu, ekivaako okufa amangu.
dis_gastric_torsion.prevention: Weewale okuliisa emmere ennene oluvannyuma lw’okusiiba okumala ebbanga eddene era emmere ya buli lunaku ogigabanyemu ebitundu.

dis_c_difficile.name: Ekirungo kya Clostridium difficile (CDI) .
dis_c_difficile.description: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya mu baana b’embizzi abaakazaalibwa ekivaako ekiddukano eky’amazzi n’okuzimba.
dis_c_difficile.prevention: Okwoza bulungi n’okutta obuwuka mu biyumba by’okuzaala era okakasa nti enseke zifuluma nga bukyali.

dis_cold_stress.name: Situleesi y’obunnyogovu (Hypothermia) .
dis_cold_stress.description: Omubiri okunyogoga ennyo mu baana b’embizzi, ekivaako okukankana n’okufa ennyo.
dis_cold_stress.prevention: Waayo amataala ag’ebbugumu, creep boxes, era ekifo w’ozaala kikuume nga kikalu era nga temuli muyaga.

dis_necrotic_enteritis.name: Obulwadde bw’omu lubuto obuyitibwa Necrotic Enteritis
dis_necrotic_enteritis.description: Obulwadde bw’obutwa bwa bakitiriya obuleeta ekiddukano eky’amaanyi eky’omusaayi n’okufa ennyo mu baana b’embizzi.
dis_necrotic_enteritis.prevention: Gema enkoko nga tonnazaala era okuume obuyonjo bw’ekkalaamu obujjuvu.

dis_navel_bleeding.name: Okuvaamu omusaayi mu nnyindo
dis_navel_bleeding.description: Okuvaamu omusaayi omungi okuva mu nnabaana mu baana b’embizzi abaakazaalibwa.
dis_navel_bleeding.prevention: Siba emiguwa gy’omu nnabaana ng’ozaalibwa era weewale okuliisa enkoko emmere erimu obutwa bwa mycotoxin.

dis_spirochetal_colitis.name: Obulwadde bw’olubuto obuyitibwa Spirochetal Colitis obw’embizzi
dis_spirochetal_colitis.description: Obulwadde bw’ekiddukano obutono mu mbizzi ezikula, ekivaako okugejja obubi.
dis_spirochetal_colitis.prevention: Okwoza mu bifo omuliira embizzi n’okujjanjaba embizzi ezikoseddwa n’eddagala eritta obuwuka.

dis_salmonella_septicemia.name: Obulwadde bwa Salmonella Septicemia
dis_salmonella_septicemia.description: Obulwadde bwa salmonella obw’amaanyi mu musaayi obuleeta olususu olwa kakobe n’okufa amangu.
dis_salmonella_septicemia.prevention: Okwawula embizzi endwadde, ddagala amazzi, era okuuma obukuumi obukakafu obw’ebiramu.

dis_prdc.name: Obulwadde bw’okussa obw’embizzi Complex
dis_prdc.description: Obulwadde bw’okussa obutabuddwamu akawuka ne bakitiriya ekivaako okusesema n’okukula obubi.
dis_prdc.prevention: Okulongoosa empewo, weewale okujjula, n’okufuga akawuka akasookerwako.

dis_ergotism.name: Obutwa mu Ergot (Ergotism) .
dis_ergotism.description: Obutwa bwa ffene okuva mu mpeke z’emmere ey’empeke ezirimu ergot, ekivaako okufa kw’ebitundu by’omubiri.
dis_ergotism.prevention: Screen feed grains for dark ergot bodies era okyuse emmere erimu obucaafu.

dis_bvdv_pig.name: Obulwadde bwa BVDV mu mbizzi
dis_bvdv_pig.description: Obulwadde bw’akawuka ka Bovine Viral Diarrhea virus okuva mu kukwatagana n’ente, ekivaako okuggyamu embuto.
dis_bvdv_pig.prevention: Embizzi zikuume nga zaawuddwa ku nte n’endiga, era zikugira okukwatagana kw’ebika ebisalagana.

dis_endocarditis.name: Obulwadde bw’omutima obuva ku bakitiriya
dis_endocarditis.description: Obulwadde bwa valve y’omutima ekivaako omutima okulemererwa n’okufa amangu mu kiseera ky’okunyigirizibwa.
dis_endocarditis.prevention: Yanguwa okujjanjaba endwadde z’ennyondo n’ebiwundu, era londa ku buzaale obusobola okukwatibwa.

dis_polyserositis.name: Obulwadde bwa Mycoplasma Polycerositis
dis_polyserositis.description: Okuzimba kw’amawuggwe, omutima n’ennyondo mu baana abaggya ku mabeere mu ngeri ya fibrinous.
dis_polyserositis.prevention: Kendeeza ku situleesi y’okuggya ku mabeere, weewale okutabula ebisasiro, era osse empewo ennungi.

dis_congenital_tremor.name: Okukankana Okuzaaliranwa
dis_congenital_tremor.description: Embeera y’obusimu mu baana b’embizzi abaakazaalibwa ekivaako okukankana okw’amaanyi.
dis_congenital_tremor.prevention: Weewale okukozesa ensigo okuva mu mbizzi ezikoseddwa era okendeeze ku situleesi y’okusiga ng’oli lubuto.

Symptoms.criticalBiosecurityDesc: High-confidence clinical match detected for legally notifiable disease: {disease} ({percent}% match).
Symptoms.emergencyContainmentProtocolSteps:
1. 🔒 Immediate Quarantine: Seal affected pen immediately; restrict personnel access.
2. 🚫 Movement Freeze: Cease all live pig, pork, feed, and manure shipments off-farm.
3. 🧼 Disinfect: Deploy boot baths & tyre dips with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda.
4. 📞 Mandatory Reporting: Contact your District Veterinary Officer immediately.
5. ⚠️ No Slaughter: Do not slaughter sick or suspect animals for meat.
Symptoms.bio_proto_asf: IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY QUARANTINE: African Swine Fever is a lethal, legally notifiable virus. 1) Lock down farm gates immediately. 2) Stop all movement of pigs, vehicles, feed, and manure. 3) Disinfect all boot baths and tyres with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda. 4) Contact your District/National Veterinary Officer immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_fmd: NOTIFIABLE EPIDEMIC ALERT: Foot-and-Mouth Disease spreads rapidly through aerosols and equipment. 1) Quarantine suspect pen immediately. 2) No live pigs or personnel movement off-site. 3) Setup tyre baths and boot dips with approved disinfectant. 4) Notify livestock authorities immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_csf: NOTIFIABLE DISEASE ALERT: Classical Swine Fever (Hog Cholera). 1) Restrict pen access and isolate suspect animals. 2) Halt all pig sales and shipments. 3) Wear dedicated boots/overalls. 4) Report to official state veterinary services immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_anthrax: DANGER - ZOONOTIC EMERGENCY: Bacillus anthracis can infect humans. 1) DO NOT OPEN CARCASSES (exposure to air causes resistant spores). 2) Isolate surviving pigs. 3) Wear full PPE. 4) Call veterinary authorities for safe incineration or deep burial with quicklime.
Symptoms.bio_proto_pseudorabies: NOTIFIABLE HERPESVIRUS ALERT: Pseudorabies / Aujeszky's causes severe neurological fatality in piglets. 1) Strict pen quarantine. 2) Control wild animals and rodents. 3) Notify state veterinary authorities immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_rabies: FATAL ZOONOTIC ALERT: Rabies transmits to humans through saliva and bites. 1) DO NOT HANDLE PIG WITH BARE HANDS. 2) Secure pen tightly. 3) Alert veterinary and public health authorities immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_vesicular_stomatitis: REPORTABLE VESICULAR LESION ALERT: Vesicular Stomatitis is clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease. 1) Isolate infected pigs immediately. 2) Wear protective gloves. 3) Report to state veterinarian for lab differential diagnosis.
Symptoms.bio_proto_senecavirus: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Senecavirus A lesions are clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). 1) Quarantine pen immediately. 2) Restrict off-farm movement. 3) Notify livestock veterinary authorities for mandatory differential PCR testing.
Symptoms.bio_proto_svd: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Swine Vesicular Disease (SVD). 1) Strict isolation of infected animals. 2) Restrict all vehicle and visitor movements. 3) Report to state animal health department immediately.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.content: By accessing and using SmartSwine app, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the service.

s2.title: 2. Description of Service
s2.content:
"SmartSwine" provides farm management tools including, but not limited to:
• Herd tracking and health data.
• Financial record keeping.
• Human Resource management.
• AI-assisted diagnostic suggestions.
• Market access information.

s3.title: 3. Data Privacy & Cloud Backup
s3.content:
You retain ownership of the data you input (herd data, financials, e.t.c.). 
Your farm data is stored securely using Google Firebase, while we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security. 
By enabling Cloud Backup, you consent to the storage and synchronization of your data across your devices. 
We do not sell your personal or farm data to third parties.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the data entered. Incorrect data in the "Feed" or "Financials" modules may result in incorrect calculations.

s4.title: 4. No Medical or Veterinary Advice (Critical Disclaimer)
s4.content:
The "Feed Calculator", "Feed Formulator", "Symptoms Analyzer" and "Disease Finder" features are for educational and informational purposes only.
• The AI results are generated by algorithms and are not a substitute for professional veterinary advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
• The User agrees to consult a licensed veterinarian before making any feeding and medical decisions regarding livestock.
• The App Owner is not liable for any livestock loss or damages resulting from the use of the app and its features.

s5.title: 5. User Responsibilities
s5.content: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their account credentials. You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account.

s6.title: 6. Prohibited Conduct
s6.content:
Users agree not to:
• Use the app for any illegal purposes.
• Attempt to reverse engineer the application.
• Input fraudulent financial data for the purpose of deceiving third parties.

s7.title: 7. Service Availability
s7.content: We strive for 99% uptime but do not guarantee uninterrupted access to the service. Data backups are provided as a convenience; however, users are encouraged to maintain their own records.

s8.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
s8.content: SmartSwine app is provided "as is." To the maximum extent permitted by law, its developers shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use the service, including livestock loss or financial discrepancies.

s9.title: 9. Financial Data
s9.content: The "Financials" module is a tracking tool and does not constitute professional accounting or tax advice. Users are encouraged to export their data for review by certified accountants.

s10.title: 10. Changes to Terms
s10.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the app constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

s11.title: 11. Contact Information
s11.content: For support or legal inquiries, please contact the developer through the app's profile settings or at bibiniitech@gmail.com.

Guide.guide_breeding_step1_desc: Noonya okuyimirira (standing reflex), ekibumba ekizimba, n’amaloboozi. Wandiika empeereza y’obutonde oba AI n’ebikwata ku boar tag.
Guide.guide_breeding_step1_tip: Enkola esinga obulungi kwe kugabula enkoko emirundi ebiri: nga baawukanye essaawa 12 mu kiseera ky’ebbugumu ery’oku ntikko ng’eyimiridde.
Guide.guide_breeding_step2_desc: SmartSwine ekola otomatiki enteekateeka y’okukebera ebbugumu okuddamu ku nnaku 18-24 n’okulabula kw’okuzaala ku nnaku 110-114.
Guide.guide_breeding_step2_tip: Kebera oba ozzeeyo mu bbugumu okwetoloola Olunaku 21. Singa sow eraga ebbugumu eriyimiridde, ddamu okugikolako amangu ddala.
Guide.guide_breeding_step3_desc: Okutta obuwuka mu bibokisi by’okuzaala n’okutambuza enkoko z’embuto ng’ebula ennaku 4 ku 5 okutuuka ku lunaku lw’okuzaala olusuubirwa. Tegeka amataala ag’ebbugumu eri abaana b’embizzi.
Guide.guide_breeding_step3_tip: Ekifo ekiwujjo ky’embizzi kikuume nga kibuguma (30-32°C) okuziyiza ebbugumu eringi mu baana abazaalibwa.
Guide.guide_breeding_step4_desc: Log Born Alive, Stillborns, Mummies, ne Total Litter Birth Weight okwekenneenya enkola ya maama w’okusiga.
Guide.guide_breeding_step4_tip: Muwe empiso z’ekyuma era osala amannyo g’empiso mu ssaawa 24-48 ng’omaze okuzaala.
Guide.guide_breeding_subtitle: Londoola enzirukanya y’ebbugumu ly’okusiga, ennaku z’okugabula, olubuto olw’ennaku 114, n’okuzaala.
Guide.guide_feed_step1_desc: Genda ku ‘Feed’ oggulewo ekintu ‘Feed Formulation’ okukola oba okutereeza emmere ey’okuliisa ey’enjawulo.
Guide.guide_feed_step1_tip: Kebera emiwendo gy’ebirungo mu katale nga bukyali okuzuula ensibuko za puloteyina n’amasoboza mu kitundu ezisinga okukekkereza ssente.
Guide.guide_feed_step2_desc: Londa omutendera gw’embizzi ogugendereddwamu (Creep, Starter, Grower, Finisher, Gestating Sow, Lactating Sow) okutikka ebiriisa ebyetaagisa ebya mutindo.
Guide.guide_feed_step2_tip: Embizzi ezirima zeetaaga ebirungo ebizimba omubiri ebingi (16-18%) okusinga embizzi ezirina olubuto (12-14%).
Guide.guide_feed_step3_desc: Oteekamu ebirungo nga Emmwaanyi, Soya Meal, Wheat Bran, Fishmeal, ne Premix. Bbalansi ebitundu ku kikumi okutuusa ng’ebbaala z’ebiriisa zifuuse kiragala.
Guide.guide_feed_step3_tip: Kakasa nti omugerageranyo gwa Calcium ne Phosphorus (Ca:P) gusigala wakati wa 1.2:1 ne 1.6:1 okusobola okukula obulungi amagumba.
Guide.guide_feed_step4_desc: Teeka enkola yo ey’okufumba enzikiriziganya okusobola okufuna amangu, oba wandiika ekibinja ekitabuddwa okusobola okulongoosa mu ngeri ey’otoma yinvensulo y’emmere.
Guide.guide_feed_step4_tip: Tabula emmere mu bitundutundu ebifaanagana era otereke mu paleedi enkalu, ezigulumivu okuziyiza obutwa bwa aflatoxin n’okwonooneka.
Guide.guide_feed_subtitle: Dizayini emmere etali ya ssente nnyingi, erimu ebiriisa ku buli mutendera gw’okufulumya.
Guide.guide_finances_step1_desc: Wandiika ensaasaanya yonna ku faamu ng’egabanyizibwamu okusinziira ku mmere y’emmere, ey’obusawo bw’ebisolo, ey’abakozi, eby’okukozesa, n’okuddaabiriza.
Guide.guide_finances_step1_tip: Log expenses amangu ddala nga okugula kubaddewo kale okwekenneenya omuwendo kusigala nga ku mulembe.
Guide.guide_finances_step2_desc: Wandiika ssente eziyingira okuva mu kutunda ebisolo ebiramu, emirambo egyasaliddwa, ebisolo ebirundibwa oba obusa obw’obutonde.
Guide.guide_finances_step2_tip: Wandiika obuzito obulamu n’ebbeeyi esembayo buli kkiro okulondoola emigabo gy’akatale egyatuukirira.
Guide.guide_finances_step3_desc: Weekenneenye COP buli kkiro ne Finisher Breakeven price okukakasa nti buli transaction ekola amagoba amalungi.
Guide.guide_finances_step3_tip: Emmere y’emmere mu ngeri ennungi erina okukiikirira ebitundu 65-75% ku nsaasaanya yo yonna ey’okufulumya. Okukendeeza ku kwonoona emmere y’ebisolo.
Guide.guide_finances_subtitle: Londoola ensaasaanya, ssente eziyingira mu kutunda, era obala omuwendo gw’ebintu ebikolebwa buli kkiro.
Guide.guide_health_step1_desc: Kozesa ekintu ekizuula endwadde okukwataganya obubonero obw’obujjanjabi obwetegerezeddwa (okusesema, ekiddukano, ebiwundu) n’embeera z’embizzi eza bulijjo.
Guide.guide_health_step1_tip: Ebisolo ebirwadde byawula mangu mu biyumba bya kalantiini nga tonnatandika kujjanjabwa.
Guide.guide_health_step2_desc: Wandiika obujjanjabi bw’eddagala eritta obuwuka oba eritta obuwuka era weetegereze nnyo ennaku z’okuggyamu ennyama.
Guide.guide_health_step2_tip: Tosuubula oba kusala nsolo ng’eddirisa ly’okuggyamu ennyama enzijuvu terinnaggwaako.
Guide.guide_health_step3_desc: Kuuma ebifo ebinaabirwamu ebigere n’eddagala eritta obuwuka, okufuga abagenyi abagenda ku faamu, okuyonja mmotoka, n’okuteeka sitooka empya mu kalantiini okumala ennaku 30.
Guide.guide_health_step3_tip: Biosecurity ya buseere emirundi 10 okusinga okujjanjaba obulwadde obubalukawo.
Guide.guide_health_step3_title: Okussa mu nkola obukuumi bw’ebiramu ku faamu
Guide.guide_health_subtitle: Zuula obubonero, goberera enkola z’obujjanjabi, n’okukuuma obukuumi bw’ebiramu obukakafu.
Guide.guide_herd_step1_desc: Yingira mu ‘Herd Data’ okuva ku dashboard enkulu oba menu ya drawer okulaba registry yo yonna ey’ekisibo.
Guide.guide_herd_step1_tip: Osobola okusengejja ebiwandiiko by'ekisibo okusinziira ku mbeera (Active, Sold, Cull) ng'okozesa tabu z'embeera.
Guide.guide_herd_step2_desc: Koona ku '+' ekitengejja. Jjuzaamu ebikulu: Tag ID, Olulyo, Ekikula, Olunaku lw’amazaalibwa, n’ekifo ekkalaamu.
Guide.guide_herd_step2_tip: Teeka ID za tag ezitegeerekeka obulungi, ezituukiridde (e.g., SOW-001, BOAR-01) okusobola okwanguyirwa okulondoola mu faamu yonna.
Guide.guide_herd_step3_desc: Ggulawo kaadi y’ekisolo kyonna okuwandiika obuzito bwa minzaani bulijjo, okugema, okuggya ensowera, oba obujjanjabi.
Guide.guide_herd_step3_tip: Okupima buli kiseera kiyamba okubala Average Daily Gain (ADG) entuufu n’okuzuula obulwadde nga bukyali.
Guide.guide_herd_step4_desc: Embizzi ezirima zigatta mu biyumba ebiragiddwa oba mu bibinja by’ebibinja okusobola okulondoola obulungi obungi bw’ebiyumba n’emmere gye zinywa.
Guide.guide_herd_step4_tip: Weewale ebiyumba ebijjudde abantu okuziyiza enneeyisa y’okuluma n’okukakasa nti ebisolo bikula mu ngeri y’emu.
Guide.guide_herd_subtitle: Okuwandiisa ebisolo, okuddukanya obubonero bw’amatu, okugaba ebiyumba, n’okulondoola olunyiriri.
Guide.guide_hr_step1_desc: Okuwandiisa abakozi, abaddukanya faamu, n‟abasawo b‟ebisolo abeebuuzibwako nga balina olukusa lw‟okuyingira olukwata ku mirimu.
Guide.guide_hr_step1_tip: Okukugira okufuna ssente eri Admins ne Managers kikuuma ebiwandiiko ebikulu nga bikuumiddwa bulungi.
Guide.guide_hr_step1_title: Yongera ku Bammemba ba Ttiimu & Okugaba Emirimu
Guide.guide_hr_step2_desc: Muwe emirimu gya buli lunaku ng’okuliisa mu kkamera, okuyonja ekyuma ekifukirira, essaawa z’okuzaala, n’okuzuula ebbugumu.
Guide.guide_hr_step2_tip: Enkalala z‟emirimu ezitegeerekeka obulungi zitangira okusubwa okuliisa oba okulwawo lawundi z‟eddagala.
Guide.guide_hr_step2_title: Gabira Emirimu & Enteekateeka za Buli lunaku
Guide.guide_hr_step3_desc: Wandiika okusasula emisaala, bbonuusi, n’okuggyibwako okukuuma ebyafaayo by’omusaala ebitegeerekeka obulungi, ebitegekeddwa.
Guide.guide_hr_step3_tip: Bulijjo ssaako ebiwandiiko ku bbonuusi z’omulimu oba ssente z’omusaala okusobola okutegeera obulungi okubala.
Guide.guide_hr_subtitle: Dukanya abakozi, okugaba emirimu egya buli lunaku, okulondoola abayizi abajja, n’okuwandiika omuwendo gw’omusaala.
Guide.guide_intro_desc: Enkola z’emirimu ezikwatagana mu mitendera ku mutendera okulongoosa obulamu bw’ekisibo, okukola emmere y’ebisolo, enzirukanya y’okuzaala, eby’ensimbi, n’okuddukanya abakozi.
Guide.guide_no_results: Tewali miramwa gya ndagiriro gikwatagana gyazuuliddwa
Guide.guide_offline_step1_desc: Wandiika ebisolo ebigattibwako, ebiwandiiko by’emmere, empeereza y’okuzaala, n’obujjanjabi ne bwe kiba nga tewali Wi-Fi oba siginiini ya ssimu.
Guide.guide_offline_step1_tip: Enkyukakyuka zonna ziterekebwa mu kitundu mu kifo eky'obukuumi eky'ekyuma kyo ekitali ku mutimbagano.
Guide.guide_offline_step2_desc: Omukutu gwa yintaneeti bwe gukomezeddwawo, ebipya byonna ebitali ku mukutu bikwatagana butereevu ne database y’ekire.
Guide.guide_offline_step2_tip: Kebera banner etali ku mutimbagano waggulu ku screen okukakasa embeera yo ey'okuyungibwa mu kiseera kino.
Guide.guide_offline_subtitle: Kola bulungi nga tolina yintaneeti mu kkalaamu eziri ewala; sync automatically nga ezzeemu okuyungibwa.
Guide.guide_search_placeholder: Noonya emitwe, emirimu, oba enkola y'emirimu...
Guide.guide_weight_step1_desc: Minzaani bw’eba tewali, pima obuwanvu bw’omutima emabega w’amagulu g’omu maaso n’obuwanvu okuva ku matu okutuuka ku musingi gw’omukira.
Guide.guide_weight_step1_tip: Olutambi olupima lukuume nga lunywedde ku lususu lw’embizzi nga tonyiga nnyama.
Guide.guide_weight_step2_desc: SmartSwine ebala ADG wakati w’okupima okulondoola enkola y’okukula okusinziira ku bipimo ebya mutindo.
Guide.guide_weight_step2_tip: Target ADG eri abalimi b’ettunzi eri 650g - 850g/day wansi w’endya ennungi.
Guide.guide_weight_step3_desc: Laba olunaku olusuubirwa okusala akatale (target 90-100kg) okuteekateeka embalirira y’emmere y’ebisolo n’okutunda abaguzi mu maaso.
Guide.guide_weight_step3_tip: Tegeka okutunda finisher yo nga bukyali okusobola okusiba mu ndagaano z’abaguzi ennungi.
Guide.guide_weight_subtitle: Teebereza obuzito bw’embizzi, londoola sipiidi y’okukula, n’okuteebereza ennaku z’okusala.
